تسترخصن (form X)
# تَسْتَرْخِصْنَ (tastarḵiṣna) /tas.tar.xisˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# تُسْتَرْخَصْنَ (tustarḵaṣna) /tus.tar.xasˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
